source.citation: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File extract (eo_<state>.csv and eo_xx.csv, retrieved 2026-10-12; organizations with status 01, currently recognized), counted by NTEE Core Code (National Center for Charitable Statistics); counties from each organization's ZIP by the Census ZCTA-to-county relationship files (the county where most of the ZIP's people lived in 2010, else most of its land in 2020); an organization at a post-office-box ZIP takes the county where most of its city's other organizations are. Churches need not register with the IRS, so congregations are a floor. County populations are the 2010 census counts in the same relationship file.
